Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a dense consolidation in the right upper lobe that is sharply demarcated by the horizontal fissure, along with patchy opacity in the left lower zone. There is no evidence of pleural effusion (costophrenic angles appear clear), which aligns with the description in option C and helps distinguish it from typical bacterial pneumonia or heart failure which often present with effusions.
